core.title: Keep train and wagon references bidirectional (Train - Wagon Coverage)
core.given: A plan containing trains and/or wagon manifests (either side may be empty), plus the plan's allow-list of wagons exempt from train membership
core.when: the planner adds, removes, renames, or changes the status of a wagon manifest; adds, removes, or edits a train's participants; or changes the exemption allow-list
core.then: Keep train-wagon coverage bidirectional with no orphan: every wagon appears in at least one train's participants (wagon -> train), and every wagon reference in a train's participants resolves to a wagon manifest (train -> wagon).
prefer: When creating a wagon manifest, add it as a participant of at least one train in the same change.
When adding a wagon reference to a train's participants, create or point to an existing wagon manifest in the same change.
When renaming or removing a wagon, update every train participant that references it.
When removing a wagon from the exemption allow-list or promoting it out of draft status, add it to a train in the same change.
avoid: Leaving an orphan on either side: a wagon in no train, or a train participant with no wagon manifest.
Adding a wagon to the exemption allow-list or marking it draft just to silence the coverage check.
unless: wagon -> train direction only: the wagon is listed in the exemption allow-list or has draft status.
core.why: Bidirectional coverage means each side references the other with no orphan: every non-exempt wagon is reachable from a train, and every wagon reference in a train resolves to a wagon manifest.
evidence: The wagon -> train coverage check passes: every wagon appears in at least one train's participants, excepting allow-listed or draft wagons.
The train -> wagon coverage check passes: every wagon reference in a train's participants has a wagon manifest.
verification: Two independent direction checks: wagon -> train requires every wagon manifest to appear in at least one train's participants; train -> wagon requires every wagon participant reference to resolve to a wagon manifest. Each check fires even when the other side (trains or wagons) is empty.
Exceptions apply to the wagon -> train direction only (the exemption allow-list and draft status); the train -> wagon direction has no exceptions.
Scope: the checks cover wagon/train reference structure only; edits to wagon content that do not change wagon identity, status, allow-list membership, or train participants are not covered.

values: wagon removed from the exemption allow-list

fires: Planner adds a new non-draft wagon manifest, not listed in the exemption allow-list, that no train lists in its participants.
Planner adds a wagon manifest while the plan has no trains at all, and the wagon is neither draft nor in the exemption allow-list.
Planner adds a wagon reference to a train for which no wagon manifest exists (including when the plan has no wagon manifests).
Planner renames or deletes a wagon manifest still referenced by a train participant.
Planner removes or edits a train so that a non-draft, non-allow-listed wagon is no longer in any train.
Planner promotes a wagon out of draft status without adding it to any train, and it is not in the exemption allow-list.
Planner removes from the exemption allow-list a non-draft wagon that is not in any train.
doesNotFire: A wagon with draft status is not yet in any train.
A wagon listed in the exemption allow-list is not in any train.
Edits to wagon content (features, WMBTs, acceptances) that do not change wagon identity, status, allow-list membership, or train participants.

profileRequirements.meaning: The concrete plan-artifact kinds this rule reads: the train artifacts, the wagon manifests, and the wagon exemption allow-list (the artifact whose entries exempt a wagon from train membership).
How a train's participant entry refers to a wagon — the reference whose resolution the train -> wagon direction checks.
profileRequirements.bunValue: a train participant entry beginning with `wagon:` (the `wagon:` participant)

profileRequirements.meaning: How the plan marks a wagon manifest as draft, i.e. not yet required to be in a train.

proposedKeys.meaning: The plan's concrete construct that marks a wagon manifest as draft (not yet required to be covered by a train).
proposedKeys.whyNoExistingKey: No key describes plan-artifact status values: the urn group covers only URN shapes and bindings, roles cover artifact kinds/paths, and the idiom group has no plan-status construct.

neutralityNotes: The convention is a plan-model rule, so it is almost fully neutral already. 'train', 'wagon', 'WMBT', 'feature' and 'acceptance' are plan-artifact concepts present in the closed vocabulary (urn artifacts), not stack terms, and are kept. Three concrete bindings come from the profile: the plan-artifact kind names incl. the exemption allow-list (roles.plan_artifact.kinds: wagons_not_in_train_allow_list), the wagon reference syntax in a train's participants (urn.wagon: the `wagon:` prefix), and the draft status spelling (proposed idiom.wagon_draft_status: status:draft). The two validator ids (test_all_wagons_in_at_least_one_train, test_all_train_wagon_refs_exist) and the finding ids are Bun realization details kept in bunOnly; core.verification describes the two direction checks generically, including that each fires even when the opposite side is empty, that exceptions apply only to the wagon -> train direction, and the documentation-only disposition.
